pins.title: Retake One Section, Not Your Whole Video
pins.description: Record a script section by section and redo the part you fluffed. Keep the takes you like, with each section saved separately.

pins.title: A Teleprompter That Waits When You Pause
pins.description: Voice Pace moves the words while you talk and stops when you pause, so you can deliver your script at a natural pace.

pins.title: Keep Your Notes Near the Camera Lens
pins.description: Read your script beneath the camera while recording, helping you keep your eyes on the lens and stay connected with your audience.

pins.title: Rehearse Your Presentation to a Target Time
pins.description: Use fit-to-time to adjust the scroll for a presentation or video length, then rehearse until the pacing feels right.

pins.title: Free Recording With No Watermark
pins.description: Record with the script by the lens and save takes to Photos without a watermark. Cue Plus is planned as a one-time payment, not a subscription.

reddit.question: What’s a good teleprompter app for recording short videos?
reddit.reply: Look for one that keeps the script close to the lens and saves recordings without a watermark. A new iPhone teleprompter is in the works with free recording and section-by-section retakes.

reddit.question: Any teleprompter apps that pause when I stop speaking?
reddit.reply: Voice-paced scrolling can help: the text moves while you talk and waits when you pause. One upcoming iPhone option is built around that, with Voice Pace planned as a one-time Plus upgrade.

reddit.question: What should I use to rehearse a presentation to a specific length?
reddit.reply: A teleprompter with fit-to-time can adjust the scroll for your target duration. There’s an upcoming iPhone app with that feature, plus recording without a watermark.
